name: alp-desktop
description: ALP desktop shell for macOS: opens the user's installed alp web in its own window (D32).

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/main.cjs && rm -rf dist/pages && cp -R src/pages dist/pages
scripts.start: bun run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
